rationales.authenticity: Signs of labor (waters breaking, regular pains) and breech detection are historically accurate midwife wisdom.
rationales.character: Expert, authoritative midwife voice with practical obstetric knowledge; strong professional persona.
rationales.craft: Two substantive sentences covering labor onset and breach complication; specific, evocative.
rationales.language: Strong en-IE with 'Aye', ''Tis', 'sharp-like'; one minor rhythm issue in second sentence.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly and comprehensively answers when to summon the midwife with obstetric detail.
